analysis.purpose: The test suite for secrets — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: M1.4 secret scanner — pure; M1.4 persist-time guard — GATE: canary secret never reaches a committed artifact; M1.4 crib export --redact — evidence quotes → span refs, secrets masked.
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of secrets
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
